name: TS-S1101-24ETXGTXGF-AresE2 (PoE switch)

buses.title: PoE bus (PSE controllers through isolator U26)
buses.note: SDA PB11 -> U26 pin 2 (ASDA), SCL PB10 -> U26 pin 3 (ASCL) - exactly as the Si8600 datasheet says. Scanned live on 2026-09-14: 0x20, 0x21, 0x23 (the PSE chips) plus 0x0C, 0x22, 0x30, 0x60. The earlier note claiming the pair was crossed came from misreading the bus object in RAM, not from the board.

buses.title: Service bus (always busy, used as control channel)
buses.note: Firmware talks on it constantly; a scan here proves the method works

notes: Repaired 2026-09-14: dead isolator U26 blocked all commands to the PSE chips, PoE was down on every port while 48 V and the PSE chips themselves were fine.
